system.description:
Calling out a name over the barrier of death, you drag a restless spirit to attendance, forcing it to manifest and answer to your will.

You must know the wraith's name (or have a clear image of its persona from The Spirit's Touch) and possess an object it contacted in life; if that object is a Fetter, you gain a free retest. Make a Mental Challenge against the wraith, retesting with Occult. If you win (or the wraith wishes to come), it is pulled to you, becoming visible and audible; you may ask a single question, which it must answer truthfully. After one turn the ghost fades unless it stays or is coerced with further Necromancy.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
